book.name: Wangarini
book.title: Wangarini kuku Nuw Wangi siyaam yandakuri, Isusoo kuk kamanchintspa

content: Minootssha kamanchintspa; yuwaa minush zar Isus yusur tuchparinshtini iyaa yakarangu anootsi
¿Wanipamasaja zari? chungparee zar maayaruni, Isus iyash yusur yakarangiya musamuna Galileyamuna.

Iysha, Isusini wipunashini Galileyap tsap naateeruni, anush washunand shaniyaranganiya; Pitorpat, misha Tomáspat, misha Natánaypatatam Kanágashuchi tputsi, misha nuwaptatam, misha nuwapat zuwanllina Sandeekurinpatatam, Sípitiyurini wipini, misha tsimbunutamta tputsi, aship an shaniyaranganiya.

Pitorsha iyaa: Nuwma kawatama, táyaru, iysha ichinguruni, Pza, iysha istani, tárangini. Ashiriya, yareeruni, botish zaruranginiya. Psaan kawakuni, ngutaritini taraseeranginiya; kayupchee nda minamtiyam putaranginiya.
Zar yakatanu, Isussha wingumun xiyxeew ashirangiya. Itaru, iy nda natstarangini Isusootsi.
Isussha kuruzeeru, Nlluris, ¿zapan kayupchee putayanllis siya? átu, Pitorsha: Nda minamtiyam putarangeezini, táranginiya Isusootsi.

Isussha: Mbutsunungich yachangints; taarcha kayupchi, tárangu, iysha ayu atuni, amb kapeetaranganiya. ¡Maya! areetush kapunguri tatsiteeru, itsiramaam pinasaranginiya. Izichtapa tuni, mazachimun pshiyreeni, táranginiya.

Nuwsha: Pitoroo, Isustanda; iycha kurakarini, táranguri, Pitor anoo mazinayaru, wamaree kamartarangiya, watam iy uru turustayaruni kawatariniwa. Kamartayaru, kungush chipuyarangiya; Isusup naatarangiya.
Iysha ichinguruni apinlliri naataranganiya kanushu. Arapeeja naatarangini; kuruzkuch kimtaru ashee naatarangani. Areetaa pshiyratanuni matayaranganiya.
Matayaramchuni, sumasee parangini. Isus masunllpat tazuyaru, iyaam ksirangiya kayupcheetsi. Pangaa anshutam wayarangiya.
Isussha: Pitoroo, kayupich yashini, táyaru,

Pitorsha botip iyaptatam zaruyaruni, areetaa putayaruni, mazachimun pshiyrarangani. Kayupchee wazapan kawaranginiya. Washunand 153 putaranginiya watarinandarita. Kapungtaa tatsiteeru, ashiritaa areet nda izichirangiya.

Iwapayaruni, Isussha: Neewa ktungangints; tárangu, katungtsee mbaseeru, iyaam panarangiya. Iysha anoo katungaranganiya. Antaati iy: ¿Chakshasha shiya? tárangeezini, nda. Watam ichinguruni natstaranginiwa Isusootsi.
Ashirucha, washunand shaniyaranguni, nipta iyash tuchip zar yakarangiya. Isus tsiparangitaa, támarangiya. Támeeru, iyash yakarangu, iysha kchiptini washunandari zapanni parangtanicha.

Ashiriya, katungtsee kawatspayaruni, Isus Pitorpat tsiyatarangiya. Zuwaa Pitoroo, ¿chak nuwaa kizpur chinaka? ¿Kaapa shiy nuwaa chinakish? tárangiya Isusu. Pitorsha: Isusoo, shaana nuwaa yasaksha; nuw shiyaa kizpur chinakina, tárangiya. Isussha: Ashiri tputsireetsi tayaspatangcha shiya, tárangiya.

Táyaru, yusur tayusarangiya Isusu. Isussha: Pitoroo, ¿tamaru shiy nuwaa chinaksha? tárangu, Pitorsha: Ichee, nuw shiyaa kizpur chinakina, tárangiya. Isussha: Ashiriya, tputsireetsi ishinangcha; ksutangcha shiya, tárangiya.

Táyaru, yusur tuchparinshtini Isus tayusirangiya. Pitoroo, ¿kaapa shiy nuwaa chinakish? átu, Pitorsha kizpur mang' mantsarangiya. Mang' mantsayaru, Pitorsha: Ichee, shiy watam ichinguru yasakshawa. Zuraktana átana; nuw shiyaa kizpur chinaktana, tárangiya Pitoru. Isussha, Ashiri tputsireetsi napangcha; wanasiri tayaspatangcha.

Na kaapa mazinangcha; Kanungasimasish kizpur taarangsha. Yap shaana zandkish amb yareerush kis naatarsha. Itaru, nimun zapish kizpur wachinakchush ndusha ashtachish; kizpur taachtazish; kuwish ngutish paxayarush, nllitaritsha tputs kuweetsish kamuriyarusin, shiyaa machchinllinaya; yap nda zandkish amb shiyaa machchiya.

Ashiritaa, tsipaneetsish nda pachindkush, nuwash tchitangandama; tárangiya Isusu. Isus anoo kamanku, Pitoroo watsipun wasina kamanirangiya. Pitor mangutaja tsipach. Itaru, nuw kamini tsipachiya. Apanllsha anoo zandkiya átu, Isus tárangiya.

Ashiriya, Isus Pitoroo anoo kamanirangu, Pitorsha natpunuyaru nuwaa naparangiya. Pitorsha: Isusoo, ¿Wangawa; tamayree uw tsipach? tárangiya. Pitor nuwaa mashirangparee, watam Isus nuwaa kizpur chinaranguwa. Sirútari yaani Isuspat katungaranguni, Isusunungiri ipunarangina. Pitor nuwap napeeru, nuwsha Isusumun kandaniranguri, witsshuri kazambarangina; ¿Chak shiyaa tamapingach? tárangina.

Ashiriya, Pitor na nuwaa mashirangu, Isussha: Pitoroo, anoo shiy chinarinllpa. Nuwaana yasakina Wangaatsi. Nuwaana zandkinaareena, tputs Wangaa pachamaam waritaktamcha. Waani taap atinaareena, nduma yusur kuschuri, ¿tamareeja tsipach? Ashiri shiysha anoo chinarinllpa; shiy nuwash tchitangandama, tárangiya Isusu. Táyaru, kasarangiya.

Ashirucha, na anumunarisha tsiyatsis nuwamun izapaneerangiya. Wang tsipacheeja, ndambaree, Isuschich atanaya nuwaatsi. Itaru, mamarpakanaya. Antaati Wang tsipacheeja, tárangeeja Isusu, nda; itaru mangutari, Nuwaana zandkinaareena, waani taap atinaareena, nduma yusur kuschuri, tsipamaam wanindaja, mangu, tárangiya nuwaatsi. Ashiri yuwaa Isus tuchparinshtini iyaa yakarangu anoo kamaneena.
Ashirucha, in watacha siyaam yandakina. Nuwaana kachi parangi anuri yandakina. Ashiri ngichiz nduncha. Nuw kuki itsinsamcha.

¿Antaati ichingurooja yandarangi? nda. ¿Isusoo wanipaja nuw kachi parangi? ¡Maya! ichinguru yandakinaareena, kirakaa izuuru kachingachparina. ¿Tamayree ichinguru yandachich? ¿Yapeeja ichinguru wayachich? Itaru, siyaa mangoonpana aturi, ipus ipus sheeruri, siyaam yandaktana. Ashiriya, mangoonangtsa átana; wapparee. [Watamaritcha Isus kuku.]
